summary: The implementation successfully addresses all 6 requirements (REQ-42 through REQ-47) with comprehensive vendor and product management functionality. The backend function updateProductByAdmin is implemented with proper authorization checks, frontend components for vendor overview and product drill-down views are added, and React Query hooks with proper cache invalidation are in place. The diff shows complete implementation of the admin product editing workflow.

hallucinated_features.reason: The diff shows CommissionEditor component usage and handleEditCommission function, but commission management was not part of the BuildRequest requirements. This appears to be existing functionality being preserved rather than newly added.

The diff shows delete dialog and handleDeleteClick/handleDeleteConfirm functions with deleteVendor mutation, but vendor deletion was not requested in the BuildRequest. This may be pre-existing functionality.

The vendorStats calculation with useMemo appears incomplete and includes a comment indicating it will be calculated from backend data structure, suggesting this may be partially implemented or experimental code not requested in requirements.
